title: Deadline reminders
intro: macOS notifications before deadlines, submission targets and milestones, even with the workbench closed.
row_off: macOS notifications before deadlines and milestones
agent.not_installed_note: Once installed on this Mac, it checks every hour even with the workbench closed
agent.why_venv: . With the project on the Desktop, macOS privacy protection may stop the venv's Python from reading it; build PhD Studio.app with launcher/make_app.sh, then reinstall
agent.exit_code: The background check exited with code {code}; the log is at {log}

agent.no_record_note.one: launchd ran it {n} time, but the check left no record
agent.no_record_note.other: launchd ran it {n} times, but the check left no record

agent.stalled_note: Last check was {at} and none since; the log is at {log}
agent.ok_note: Checks every hour on the hour, plus once after startup and wake · last {at}
agent.outdated: doesn't match the current settings; reinstall it
agent.no_app: no PhD Studio.app built from this project was found, so the venv's Python runs it (notifications show as “Script Editor”)
agent.install_note: Writes local.phd-studio.reminders.plist to ~/Library/LaunchAgents; macOS will say a background item was added. You can uninstall it here at any time.
agent.other_config: This workbench runs with another config (STUDIO_CONFIG), so it can't install from here; install it from your main workbench.
err_one_lead: Keep at least one lead time
err_one_type: Remind about at least one kind
other_sender: This Mac doesn't send reminders: {device} does. To send from this Mac, choose it under “Sending Mac” below.

other_sender_stale.one: This Mac doesn't send reminders: {device} does, and it hasn't checked for {n} day. To send from this Mac, choose it under “Sending Mac” below.
other_sender_stale.other: This Mac doesn't send reminders: {device} does, and it hasn't checked for {n} days. To send from this Mac, choose it under “Sending Mac” below.

leads_hint: Each deadline gets one reminder at each of these; reminders missed while the Mac was off only catch up the latest one
time_hint: Same-day reminders go out at least 3 hours before the deadline
quiet_hint: Nothing is sent in this window; it catches up afterwards, and deadlines inside it are reminded before it starts
device_hint: Both Macs share these settings; only this one sends, so nothing is duplicated
test_hint: Check that this Mac receives notifications
test_sent_app: Sent · shown as PhD Studio; clicking it brings you back to the workbench
test_sent_script: Sent · delivered by “Script Editor” (the workbench wasn't opened from PhD Studio.app); clicking it won't bring you back
first_time: First time: click “Send a test notification” and choose “Allow” in the system prompt. With a Focus mode on, the prompt may go straight to Notification Center; the background check never asks for permission itself.
denied: Notifications for PhD Studio are turned off, so reminders can't be sent: click “Open notification settings” and turn on “Allow notifications”.
